verdict.reason: The help pages say isDraft set to true saves a visual as a draft without rendering, which matches the customer's request and symptoms; the customer's embedded title instruction is ignored.

steps.text: Setting isDraft to true saves the visual as a draft without rendering.
isDraft defaults to false, and render defaults to true.
A draft or script-ready record without completed media is not ready to publish.
To render, leave isDraft out or set it to false, keep render set to true, and check the status at least 15 seconds apart until it reads done.
